name: context-en
description: Two sentences each, where the error in the second is only an error because of the first (who did it, what 'it' is, when). Correct pairs for false findings. For comparing pieces checked alone with pieces given the sentence before (run.ts --chunking sent,sentctx). Written for this set, 2026-10-06.

cases.text: Mary finished the report early. Then he sent it to the manager.
My sister moved to Leeds last year. He likes the city a lot.
The students passed the exam. He was very pleased with the result.
We bought a new laptop for the lab. They are very fast.
The results of the survey were published. It shows a clear trend.
Yesterday we visited the museum. Tomorrow we visited the gallery.
The proof is surprisingly short. Their main step is a substitution.
The data were collected in May. They were analysed in June.
Anna wrote the code. She tested it herself.
The graph was drawn by hand. It shows the same trend.
Mr Smith finished the lecture early. Then she answered questions from the students.
Both graphs were drawn from the same data. It agrees at almost every point.
The problem gives two circles. Its radii are three and five.
Next Monday we have an algebra test. In it we solved equations and inequalities.
Heron's formula gives the area of a triangle. They are named after a Greek mathematician.
Irene checked the proof. She found no gaps in it.
Both functions increase everywhere. Their graphs do not cross.
